create_jais2_causal_lm: create a Jais2ForCausalLM model from a VllmConfig for inference-only causal language modeling
build_jais2_model: build a Jais2Model with embedding layers, decoder layers, and normalization from a VllmConfig
build_jais2_attention: build a Jais2Attention module with QKV projection, rotary embeddings, and attention with sliding window support
build_jais2_decoder_layer: build a Jais2DecoderLayer with self-attention, MLP, and layer norms for transformer inference
build_jais2_mlp: build a Jais2MLP with column/row parallel linear projections and ReLU-squared activation
